descrizione: Your mailboxes, OpenRouter key and AI models, and how the assistant reads your mail.

casella_collegata.testo: Reading and sending are allowed. Check the initial import below.

permessi_incompleti.testo: Google didn’t grant both reading and sending. Choose Authorize and allow both on the consent screen.

da_ricollegare.testo: Choose Reconnect so the app can keep syncing while you’re away.

casella_non_trovata.testo: This mailbox was disconnected or no longer exists.

richiesta_non_valida.testo: The request expired or was started in another session. Try again.

consenso_negato.testo: Nothing changed. You can try again whenever you like.

account_di_altro_utente.titolo: This mailbox belongs to another user
account_di_altro_utente.testo: A mailbox can be connected by only one user of the app at a time.

account_diverso_da_quello_atteso.titolo: A different Google account was chosen
account_diverso_da_quello_atteso.testo: To reconnect or authorize a mailbox, choose that mailbox’s own Google account.

pauseAttive.testo: Mail keeps syncing and new emails wait for analysis. It resumes on its own once the cause is fixed.

caselle.descrizione: The app reads and sends mail through these mailboxes. Each item in your home shows the mailbox it comes from.
caselle.nessunaTesto: Connect a Gmail mailbox to start building your home.
caselle.ricollegaTesto: Google access was revoked or has expired, so syncing is paused. Reconnect with the same account: your data is kept.
caselle.autorizzaTesto: Reading or sending wasn’t allowed. Authorize again and allow both on the Google consent screen.
caselle.scollegamentoInCorso: Disconnecting: Google access is being revoked and this mailbox’s data deleted.

stima.testo: {numero, plural, =0 {No emails to analyse} one {# email to analyse} other {# emails to analyse}} · estimated cost {costo}
stima.rinviata: You postponed the initial import. New mail is still synced and analysed.
stima.requisiti: Accept the privacy notice and save a valid OpenRouter key to start the import.
stima.primaAccesso: Reconnect or authorize this mailbox first: the import needs to read its mail.

scollega.revoca: The app’s access to this mailbox is revoked at Google.
scollega.dati: This mailbox’s emails and analyses are deleted, with the actions, waiting items and Situations that come only from them.
scollega.altre: Emails that are also in another connected mailbox stay.
scollega.nuovaImportazione: Connecting it again later starts a new initial import.

esiti.gia_decisa: This import has already started or changed. The page shows its current state.
esiti.non_trovata: This mailbox is no longer connected.
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.
esiti.casella_non_pronta: Reconnect or authorise this mailbox before starting the import.

chiave.descrizione: All AI analysis runs with your own OpenRouter key. It’s stored encrypted and never shown again after saving.
chiave.nessunaTesto: AI analysis is paused until you add a key.
chiave.consiglio: Use a key created only for this app, with a credit limit: the limit caps what the app can spend.
chiave.registrazione: Prompt logging and data settings on your OpenRouter account stay under your control. Review them on OpenRouter.

esiti.non_valida: OpenRouter rejected this key. It was saved as not valid, so AI analysis is paused until you add a working key.
esiti.credito_esaurito: The key was saved, but it has no credit left. AI analysis stays paused until credit is available.
esiti.errore_temporaneo: OpenRouter couldn’t be reached. Nothing was saved; try again in a moment.
esiti.formato_non_valido: This doesn’t look like an OpenRouter key (it starts with sk-or-). Nothing was saved.

rimuovi.pausa: AI analysis pauses, and the app asks for a new key before showing your home. Mail keeps syncing.
rimuovi.openrouter: The key is deleted only from this app. To revoke it, delete it on OpenRouter too.

modelli.descrizione: Each AI function uses its own OpenRouter model. Only models with structured output and Zero Data Retention endpoints are accepted.

classificazione_priorita.descrizione: Reads each email you receive (headers, subject, text and attachment names) to tell News & FYI from urgent and other mail, explain its priority, and suggest the title and description of a new Situation.

estrazione_attivita.descrizione: Reads received mail that isn’t News & FYI, and your sent and internal mail, with related emails and earlier results, to find actions, commitments, reminders and deadlines.

attese_risposte.descrizione: Reads sent and received mail together with open Situations, waiting items and actions, to spot requests you made, link emails across threads, and judge replies and completed actions.

riepilogo_news.descrizione: Reads the News & FYI emails received in the last 24 hours and summarises them, each point linked to its emails.

bozze_assistite.descrizione: Only when you ask for a reply or follow-up: reads the email you’re answering, its thread and the allowed context emails, and suggests a draft for you to review. It never sends anything.

sconosciuta.descrizione: An AI function of the app.

statiAiuto.ok: The model has endpoints with structured output and Zero Data Retention.
statiAiuto.incompatibile: This function is paused: the model has no endpoint with structured output and Zero Data Retention. Choose another model.
statiAiuto.non_disponibile: This function is paused: the model isn’t available on OpenRouter. Choose another model.

modelli.aiuto: Model IDs look like provider/model, as listed on openrouter.ai/models. A change applies to the next calls; if this function was paused because of its model, it resumes on its own.

esiti.incompatibile: This model has no endpoint with structured output and Zero Data Retention. Choose another one.
esiti.non_disponibile: This model isn’t available on OpenRouter. Check the ID.
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.

contesto.descrizione: Your directives for how the AI reads, classifies and prioritises your mail. They replace the default directives, but can’t remove the app’s guarantees: evidence behind every claim, and no email sent without your confirmation.
contesto.ambito: Changes apply to new emails. To apply them to mail that was already analysed, use Reanalyse.
contesto.senzaVersioni: You haven’t saved an AI context yet, so the default directives are used. They’re shown below for you to edit.

predefinite.testo: They’re saved as a new version. Your current text stays in the version history.

contesto.ripristinaAiuto: Restoring saves this text as a new version.

esiti.vuoto: Write your directives first, or restore the defaults.
esiti.troppo_lungo: The text is too long (up to 20,000 characters).
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.

preferenze.descrizione: Language, theme and time zone of the app. Text written by the AI stays in the language of each email.
preferenze.temaAiuto: Applied right away and saved to your account.
preferenze.fusoAiuto: Dates, times and deadlines are shown in this time zone.

pausa.siFermaTesto: Every call to an AI model: analysis of new mail, the News digest, suggested drafts and reanalysis. Nothing is spent on your OpenRouter key.
pausa.continuaTesto: Mail sync, reading your emails, your existing actions, waiting items and corrections, and sending drafts you confirm.
pausa.ripresa: When you resume, emails that arrived in the meantime are analysed.

consumo.descrizione: AI calls made with your key in the last 30 days, by AI function. Your OpenRouter account has the authoritative figures.
consumo.nessuno: No AI calls in the last 30 days.

rianalisi.descrizione: Runs classification and action extraction again with your current AI context and models. Your corrections are kept and always take precedence.
rianalisi.apertiAiuto: The emails of Situations with open actions or waiting items.
rianalisi.giorni: Emails from the last few days
rianalisi.nienteParte: Estimating doesn’t call any model. Nothing runs until you confirm.
rianalisi.ambitoGiorni: Emails from the last {giorni, plural, one {day} other {# days}}
rianalisi.numero: {numero, plural, =0 {No emails to reanalyse} one {# email to reanalyse} other {# emails to reanalyse}}
rianalisi.prezziMancanti: Price not available for: {funzioni}. The estimate leaves them out.
rianalisi.pausaAttiva: AI analysis is paused: the reanalysis starts once analysis resumes.

esiti.ok: Reanalysis started. It runs in the background; follow it on the Status page.
esiti.stima_scaduta: This estimate is no longer valid. Estimate again.
esiti.non_trovata: This estimate no longer exists. Estimate again.

privacy.descrizione: How your mail is read, stored and sent to AI models, and how to delete it.
privacy.accettata: You accepted version {versione} of the privacy notice.
privacy.nonAccettata: You haven’t accepted the current privacy notice (version {versione}). AI analysis stays paused until you do.

account.descrizione: Removes your account and everything the app stores about you.
account.titoloConferma: Delete your account and all its data?
account.caselle: Every connected mailbox is disconnected and its Google access revoked.
account.dati: Emails, analyses, Situations, drafts, your AI context and your OpenRouter key are deleted.
account.backup: Database backups keep data until their retention period ends, as the privacy notice explains.
account.uscita: You’re signed out right away. This can’t be undone.
account.capisco: I understand that my account and data will be deleted for good.
account.errore: The account couldn’t be deleted. Try again.
